cli_help:
usage: ranex [-h] [--version]
             {gate,journal,run,host,suite,deps,keygen,github,specification,task} ...

Deterministic governance for AI agents that build software

positional arguments:
  {gate,journal,run,host,suite,deps,keygen,github,specification,task}
    gate                gate operations
    journal             journal operations
    run                 run a command and record evidence of it
    host                strict-local host operator workflow
    suite               frozen suite operations
    deps                dependency provisioning
    keygen              generate a producer signing key
    github              the GitHub acceptance loop (host-side; no network
                        here)
    specification       specification lifecycle operations
    task                dispatch and materialise task candidates

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --version             show program's version number and exit
